name: brief
summary: Every capability in the feature folded into ONE ranked list of what to do. It COMPOSES and never recomputes — a second implementation of a number is a second answer. Two tiers because one ordering cannot hold both: dated work sorted by WHEN, everything else by worth PER HOUR OF EFFORT. Absent is not zero — a capability that never ran is NAMED, because a brief reporting nothing available when nothing looked is the lie that makes somebody stop looking.
